title: Aaye Alhe Aza Aaya Moharram Ka Mahina
body:
Aaye Alhe Aza Aaya Moharram Ka Mahina
<<MINI>>
Har Ghar Se Sada Aayinge Ab Haaye Hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
Hoyenga Shaheed Isme Mohammed Ka Nawasa
<<MINI>>
Har Ghar Se Sada Aayinge Ab Haaye Hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
1.Shabbir Pa Karne Liye Girya-o-Zari
Har Ghar Me Chaliyangi Zehra Ki Sawari
Jannat Me Lahu Royenge Sarkar-e-Madina
<<MINI>>
Har Ghar Se Sada Aayinge Ab Haaye Hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Maidan Me Kal Kaqsad-e-Shabbir Ki Khatir
Jaan Apni Uthadenge Habeeb Ibne Mazahir
Mitjayenga Kal Hur-re-Dilawar ka Sarapa
<<MINI>>
Har Ghar Se Sada Aayinge Ab Haaye Hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Hojaienge Kal Zibha Sabhi Naazou Ke Paale
Asghar Se Haseen Aun-o-Mohd Se Jiyale
Mit jayenga Ek Roz Me Zehra Ka Gharana
<<MINI>>
Har Ghar Se Sada Aayinge Ab Haaye Hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Sau Tarah Ke Maqtal Me Sitam Dhayenge Zalim
Har Ek Khadam Shah Ku Rulwayenge Zalim
Hojaiyenga Tar Khoon Me Noushaha Ka Laasha
<<MINI>>
Har Ghar Se Sada Aayinge Ab Haaye Hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Ek Hashr Bapa Howenga Dariya Ke Kanare
Kal Tadhpenga Abbas Ka Laasha Laabe Dariya
<<MINI>>
Har Ghar Se Sada Aayinge Ab Haaye Hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Jab Payenge Maidan Me Jawan Bete Ki Mayyat
Khuh jayengi Shabbir Ke Aankhou Ki Basarath
Seene Se Nikal Aayenga Akber Ka Kaleja
<<MINI>>
Har Ghar Se Sada Aayinge Ab Haaye Hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
7.Kat Jayenga Maidan Me Jis Dum Sar-e-Sarwar
Shehezadiou Ke Khaimou Pe Phir Aayenga Meshar
Bin Shah Ke Jee Payengi Kis Tarah Sakina
<<MINI>>
Har Ghar Se Sada Aayinge Ab Haaye Hussaina
<<DIVIDER>>
8.Ehsan Hai Shahezadi Ka Yeh Gham Hume bakhsha
Parwaaz Gham-e-sheh Ke Liye Hum Howe Paida
Shabbir Ka Matam Hai Hume Jaan Se Pyara
<<MINI>>
Har Ghar Se Sada Aayinge Ab Haaye Hussaina
